purpose: Web series as episodic screen productions whose story, workflow, credit, versions, and audience access are shaped by online release.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name platform, release, and version. Do not equate public view counters with unique viewers or assume one credit and rights system applies to every jurisdiction.
